query: How do I connect to the VPN from my Windows work computer?
answer: Install the GlobalConnect client from the Software Center, then sign in with your work email and approve the push notification in the Authenticator app [vpn-01]. The VPN gateway is vpn.vasterby.example [vpn-01].

query: My VPN connection keeps cutting out during the working day
answer: Switch from Wi-Fi to a wired connection and disable power saving for the network adapter if the VPN drops every few minutes [vpn-02]. If the drops persist, report them with the client log file attached [vpn-02].

query: Hur får jag VPN att fungera på min Macbook?
answer: Installera GlobalConnect från Self Service på din Mac [vpn-03]. Ge sedan appen behörighet under Systeminställningar > Integritet och starta om datorn efter installationen [vpn-03].

query: I forgot my password, how can I change it myself?
answer: Reset your password yourself at the self-service portal password.vasterby.example; you need a registered mobile number to do it [pwd-01]. New passwords must be at least 14 characters and are valid for 365 days [pwd-01].

query: Jag har glömt lösenordet och har inget mobilnummer registrerat
answer: Utan registrerat mobilnummer måste du besöka servicedesken med giltig legitimation [pwd-02]. Servicedesken i stadshuset är öppen vardagar 08–16 [pwd-02].

query: I typed the wrong password too many times and can't log in
answer: Your account locks after 10 failed sign-in attempts and unlocks automatically after 30 minutes [pwd-03]. Call the service desk if you need it unlocked sooner [pwd-03].

query: I got a new phone, how do I move my two-factor authentication?
answer: Register your new phone as a device at mysignins before resetting the old one [mfa-01]. If your old phone is lost, the service desk can give you a temporary access pass valid for 8 hours [mfa-01].

query: How do I get access to our team's shared inbox?
answer: Access to a shared mailbox is requested by the mailbox owner through the IT portal form 'Funktionsbrevlåda' [mail-01]. It appears in Outlook within 2 hours after approval [mail-01].

query: My mailbox is out of space
answer: Standard mailboxes have a 50 GB quota, so empty your Deleted Items and enable online archiving for an additional 100 GB [mail-03]. If you still need more space after that, contact the service desk [mail-03].

query: I clicked a link in a suspicious email, what should I do?
answer: If you clicked a link in a suspicious email, change your password and call the service desk immediately [mail-04].

query: Hur skickar jag ett krypterat mejl till någon utanför kommunen?
answer: Skriv [SÄKER] i ämnesraden för att kryptera ett mejl till externa mottagare [mail-05]. Mottagaren får då en länk och en engångskod för att läsa meddelandet [mail-05].

query: How do I print in colour?
answer: Colour printing is disabled by default, so your manager must request colour rights for your unit through the IT portal [print-03]. The cost is charged to the unit at 1.20 SEK per page [print-03].

query: My laptop screen cracked when I dropped it
answer: Accidental damage to your screen is covered once per device lifetime [hw-02]. Report the damage in the IT portal and bring the laptop to the service desk, where a loaner is provided while it is repaired [hw-02].

query: The screens connected through my desk dock show no picture
answer: Update the dock firmware from Software Center and reconnect the cable [hw-03]. The standard USB-C dock supports two external monitors, so this fixes black screens [hw-03].

query: Can I get admin rights on my computer?
answer: Local admin rights are not granted to regular users, though developers can apply for time-limited rights via Privilege Management for up to 4 hours [sw-03].

query: I need a program that is not in Software Center
answer: Software that is not in the Software Center catalogue requires a request with business justification, which is reviewed by the security team within 5 working days [sw-01].

query: I accidentally deleted a document from OneDrive last week
answer: You can restore it yourself from the OneDrive recycle bin, since deleted files there can be recovered for 93 days [files-02]. If that window has passed, contact the service desk, as backups are kept for one year [files-02].

query: How can I send a 300 GB file to a contractor?
answer: For a 300 GB file you should use the Filöverföring service in the IT portal, since it applies to files larger than 250 GB [files-04]. The transfer link is valid for 7 days [files-04].

query: I left my laptop on the train
answer: Report the lost laptop to the service desk immediately and file a police report; the device will be remotely wiped [sec-01]. Disks are encrypted with BitLocker, which helps protect the data [sec-01].

query: Vi har skickat personuppgifter till fel mottagare, vad gör vi?
answer: Vid en personuppgiftsincident ska ni anmäla det till dataskyddsombudet inom 24 timmar via formuläret i intranätet [sec-03]. Kommunen anmäler sedan vidare till IMY inom 72 timmar vid behov [sec-03].

query: What happens to my account on my last day at work?
answer: Your account is disabled at 17:00 on your last employment day [acc-02]. Your mailbox is kept for 90 days and can be forwarded to your manager on request [acc-02].

query: What wireless network should visitors use?
answer: Visitors should use the wireless network 'Vasterby-Gast' [wifi-01]. They register with a mobile number and receive a code valid for 24 hours [wifi-01].

query: Can I work remotely from Thailand for a month?
answer: Yes, but working from outside the EU requires approval from your manager and the security team, and you should apply at least two weeks before travel [remote-01]. Some systems block foreign IP addresses, so plan ahead [remote-01].

query: When is the helpdesk open?
answer: The service desk is open weekdays 07:30–17:00 [ops-01].

query: How do I get an older version of a SharePoint document back?
answer: Right-click the file and choose Version history to restore an older version [files-05]. SharePoint saves up to 500 versions of a document [files-05].

query: Can I paste citizen data into an AI chatbot?
answer: No, you may only use approved generative AI tools with public information, so citizen data must not be pasted in [sw-05]. The approved assistant is available in Edge with your work account, but personal data must not be pasted into it [sw-05].
